title: plate
body:
## plate

Choose plate for a rectangular mounting blank with positioned through-holes. Width/depth define the XY outline, height sets thickness, and optional holes remove material through both faces. Produces checked STL, generated SCAD and a geometry summary.

Native binding: `difference / cube / translated cylinder through-holes`. Output kind: `["geometry","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `units` | Declare mm explicitly for every dimension and translation. STL does not encode units, so consumers must also select millimetres; there is no implicit unit conversion. | `{"type":"enum","values":["mm"]}` | **required** |
| `segments` | Set the number of straight facets around every nominal circle:16–256, divisible by four; omission uses 64. Larger counts reduce circle approximation error but increase geometry cost. Diameter spans polygon vertices; the bore across flats is diameter*cos(pi/segments). | `{"type":"integer","minimum":16,"maximum":256}` | `64` |
| `translation` | Move the entire finished part by [X,Y,Z] millimetres after construction. Omission uses [0,0,0]. Each coordinate is between -100 and 100; this changes placement without changing dimensions or local hole coordinates. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100,"maximum":100},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `plate` | Choose plate for a rectangular mounting blank with positioned through-holes. Width/depth define the XY outline, height sets thickness, and optional holes remove material through both faces. Produces checked STL, generated SCAD and a geometry summary. Required only with operation plate; omit spacer. Dimensions are mm and local origin is the lower-left bottom corner. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"width":{"type":"number","minimum":0.5,"maximum":200,"required":true},"depth":{"type":"number","minimum":0.5,"maximum":200,"required":true},"height":{"type":"number","minimum":0.5,"maximum":100,"required":true},"holes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"centre":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100,"maximum":200},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2,"required":true},"diameter":{"type":"number","minimum":0.5,"maximum":200,"required":true}}},"maxItems":16,"default":[]}}}` | **required** |
